projects.name: AoE2 Hotkey Editor
projects.status: Public compiled-only demo · import, edit, reload and export checks passed; game behavior unverified
projects.summary: A clearer way to explore and edit Age of Empires II hotkeys. Browse actions, check conflicts and build a profile that fits how you play.
projects.statusDetail: The public Build C Pages demo contains compiled static artifacts only; the original application source and Git history remain private. In a fresh signed-out browser, the bundled synthetic profile loaded; House was changed from Q to F11, the browser showed one saved change, and a page reload retained it. Export review validated 444 bindings across two HKP files with one change and no conflicts; the ZIP downloaded and re-imported with House on F11 and no pending changes. Mounted Crossbowman search returned the Cavalry Archer and Heavy Cavalry Archer aliases. No personal profile or game was used. Factory defaults, unresolved contexts and native in-game import/export behavior remain unverified. The silent 5 October recording is a separate check of public Sites v13: bundled Base1 opened, House was applied to F11, a reload retained one changed binding, and the ZIP downloaded after a 444-binding, two-file review with no action conflicts. This recording does not verify in-game behavior or ZIP re-import on v13. Product testing remains ahead of streamer promotion.
